long_biography.plain_text:
Progressive Housing connects Robert D. Jarosak with property activity across Suffolk County. He owned and leased a sixteen-unit development in Greenport for several years and later led the purchase of commercial premises in Bay Shore. The company also held land interests around Huntington.

Jarosak earlier devised equipment for landscape maintenance. His patented attachment channels grass and leaves from a commercial mower through a motor-driven blower into a collection receptacle, addressing access and disposal problems encountered with earlier systems. He filed the design from Smithtown, placing this inventive work before his later property activity.
